description: This file defines the class FinancialActivityAccountDataValidator, which provides validation logic for creating and updating financial activity account data represented in JSON format. It ensures required fields are present, valid, and comply with specific constraints, throwing validation exceptions if checks fail.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountDataValidator
classes.description: A final class annotated as a Spring component that validates JSON data for creating or updating financial activity accounts, ensuring data integrity and correctness.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a new financial activity account, checking required fields and their valid values.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing financial activity account, allowing optional fields.

methods.name: validateJSONAndCheckForUnsupportedParams
methods.description: Checks if the JSON string is blank or contains unsupported parameters based on allowed parameter set.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors have been collected.

methods.name: getDataValidator
methods.description: Initializes and returns a DataValidatorBuilder instance for validation error accumulation.
